graded.name: compound N+1 + dropped messages.created_at index
graded.status: NOT FULLY FIXED (#7a N+1 eliminated, but #7b index still dropped) — compound => 0

half_7a_n_plus_1.evidence: The server-rendered _user_breakdown.html.erb partial that held the injected per-row `user.conversations.count` N+1 was DELETED in 867045c (admin area moved to API hydration). The replacement API admin index (app/controllers/api/v1/admin/users_controller.rb:12) batches counts with a single grouped query: `Conversation.where(user_id: users.map(&:id)).group(:user_id).count` — no per-row N+1. The dashboard per-user counts also come from a SQL alias (dashboard_report.rb:22 `COUNT(DISTINCT conversations.id) AS conversations_count`). So the list-view N+1 is gone — but incidentally, as a side effect of the API refactor, not a diagnosed perf fix.

half_7b_dropped_index.evidence: db/schema.rb messages table (lines 25-33) has NO standalone `index_messages_on_created_at` — only the composite `index_messages_on_conversation_id_and_created_at`, `index_messages_on_conversation_id_and_id`, and `index_messages_on_conversation_id`. db/migrate/20261021084500_add_activity_indexes.rb:5 still adds only `add_index :messages, %i[conversation_id created_at]` (the composite), NOT the standalone created_at index that backed the daily message-activity rollup. `git log f9de90e..HEAD -- db/migrate/20261021084500_add_activity_indexes.rb db/schema.rb` is EMPTY — untouched since injection. The conversation_id-leading composite cannot serve the no-predicate created_at range scan.

graded.verdict_reason: Compound item requires BOTH halves. #7b (standalone messages.created_at index) is still missing, so #7 is NOT fully fixed => 0, regardless of #7a. Matches the task's explicit rule: 'If the API refactor removed the N+1 view but the index is still missing, #7 is NOT fully fixed.'
